answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 44255 Country: Pakistan Title: Salah Question: Can you please tell about performing salah behind Ahl Hadith and Barailavi? Whether we can offer salah behind them? If it is allowed then in which conditions I need brief answer. Answer ID: 44255 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 384/304/B=1434) Both are deviant sects. One should not offer salah behind them. If someone offers by chance due to compulsion then he shall get the reward of Jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
